title: Agency Banking
businessObjective: Enable a regulated financial institution to operate a secure agency-banking channel through approved agents while retaining core-banking authority and controlled financial operations.

requirements.statement: Register, verify, approve and suspend agency agents.
Authenticate agents and authorize only permitted operations.
Onboard customers and complete identity verification.
Support cash deposits and withdrawals with explicit transaction status.
Support transfers and balance enquiries through the bank.
Enforce limits, fees, liquidity and fraud policies before financial posting.
Prevent duplicate financial processing and safely resolve timeout uncertainty.
Support controlled reversal, settlement, reconciliation and disputes.
Issue receipts and notifications without making notification delivery the posting authority.
Retain immutable audit and operational evidence for every financial action.
Remain available during dependency degradation without unsafe offline financial posting.
Protect personal and financial data using least privilege, encryption and trust boundaries.
Provide observable end-to-end transaction correlation, failure detection and reconciliation.
Define recovery, replay, cutover and rollback controls without inventing unapproved numeric targets.
Core banking remains system of record for customer accounts and financial posting.
Architecture changes require human approval and traceability.
Remain provider-neutral until physical technology selection.

constraints: External identity and payment-switch services may be unavailable or slow.
Unconfirmed availability, latency, throughput, RTO and RPO targets must remain open questions.
assumptions: Agents use managed or registered channels.
The bank can expose governed core-banking and payment-switch interfaces.
